people.imagined: His stall in Vật Hoa Thị at midday, between customers. He is grinding a lump of cinnabar in a bronze mortar and has looked up because someone said the word Peach Spring. He is delighted to be asked and is already working out the price.
people.subject: The moment: at his stall at midday he looks up from a bronze mortar with a delighted grin, one hand still on the pestle. Face (most important: the stained hands and round cheerful face): a wide, round, ruddy face with full cheeks, small bright black eyes crinkled at the corners, short bushy brows, a broad nose and a wide mouth in a gap-toothed grin; smooth skin with a few laugh lines. Hair: black streaked with grey, oiled and pulled into a short topknot held by a plain bronze pin. Body: stout and short, round shoulders, leaning forward over the work. Clothing: a long smock of coarse cream linen spotted all over with bright vermilion and azure paint, worn open over a fine robe of deep red silk with gold thread at the collar, visibly worth far more than the smock. Hands and objects: both hands held forward, the fingernails and fingertips stained bright vermilion red; in his left hand a heavy bronze mortar shaped like a small censer with a vented lid, red powder spilled on the table; beside it a red-stained gourd. A single green-bronze ring set with a blue stone on his right hand. Background: blurred market awnings in orange and blue, hanging jars of pigment. Light: warm midday sun from the upper left, a faint orange glow rising from a furnace below frame. Expression: cheerful, shrewd, a salesman who has already named his price. Palette: cinnabar, cobalt, ivory and gilt.

people.imagined: Evening under the great apricot tree outside her clinic, a queue of the sick behind her. She has just finished rolling a needle roll shut and is checking a child's pulse with two fingers, tasting nothing, thinking of her apprentice.
people.subject: The moment: under a huge apricot tree at dusk she holds a child's thin wrist with two fingers and looks down, listening. Face (most important: faintly blue lips): a small, plain, round face, tired and kind, with faintly blue lips and shadowed eyes, narrow dark brows, a short nose, brown eyes warm and patient, a few fine lines, no powder. Hair: black, simply braided and pinned flat at the nape with a wooden apricot-wood pin; a stray petal caught in it. Body: small, slight, shoulders a little rounded with leaning over patients. Clothing: a plain wrap robe the brownish colour of old apricot blossom, clean and well cut, with a narrow sash; sleeves tied back with cloth ties. Hands and objects: a rolled needle case of faded green cloth tied at her hip, in view at the edge of frame, nine pale wooden needles showing at one end; her right hand holds the child's wrist; on the left sleeve a small dark-green jade medallion polished dark. Background: blurred pink-white apricot blossom, a child's small hand in the lower corner. Light: soft low gold sun from the upper left through petals. Expression: gentle concentration, a faint worried smile. A faint pale-green hint of Wood qi on her fingers. Palette: brown-gold, blush pink, pale green.

people.imagined: A wool fair on the steppe edge. He has just lost a bet to a herder's boy on purpose, laughed, and is pressing a coin into the boy's palm, turning the gold ring on his own finger with the other hand.
people.subject: The moment: at an open-air wool fair he throws his head back laughing, a gold coin on a cord bouncing at his throat. Face: a broad, big-jawed face with a heavy nose, weathered ruddy skin, deep laugh lines, small shrewd brown eyes almost shut by the laugh, thick grizzled brows, a wide mouth with strong teeth, a short salt-and-pepper beard. Hair: thick grey-black, cropped short, bareheaded. Body: huge, broad-shouldered, deep-chested, a big man. Clothing: a plain, thick, well-woven coat of undyed brown wool with a high collar and horn buttons, no silk at all, though immaculate; under it a coarse cream shirt. At the throat one gold coin on a leather cord, the only bright thing. Hands and objects: a wide hand holding out a small gold coin between thumb and finger; on the other hand a plain red-gold ring that he turns with his thumb. Background: blurred felt tents, a pen of fat sheep, a bluish sky, bundled wool bales stacked high. Light: bright open daylight from the upper left, a little dust in the air. Expression: roaring good humour with sharp eyes inside it. Earth and metal qi only as a faint ochre warmth. Palette: wool brown, cream, one spot of gold.

people.imagined: Dusk in a harbour yard. He crouches by a sandy patch beside the quay and, without noticing, has drawn three interlocking circles with a finger. He looks up, caught, and quickly rubs them out with his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in harbour sand at dusk, he glances up from a half-drawn figure of three linked circles in the dust. Face: a thin, long, hollow-cheeked face with a high forehead and a sharp nose, sallow skin, small deep-set grey eyes under heavy lids, thin worried brows, thin lips pressed, a dry stubble; a stoop to the neck. Hair: thin grey-brown, tied in a small knot with a plain star-iron rod (a short dark grey-black pin) through it, the one trace of his old abbey. Body: thin and stooped, bent forward, shoulders high. Clothing: a robe of sand-coloured cloth, well cut but dusty at the hem, cross collar, long sleeves rolled back over the forearms; at the waist a plain cord. Hands and objects: the right forefinger black with dust, tracing in the sand; in the left a small round shield of dark wood leaning on his knee, scratched all over inside; at his side a roll of cheap cloth printed with a pattern of stars. Background: blurred wooden quay, dark masts, a dim harbour. Light: low dusk from the left, orange on the sand, the face half in shade. Expression: wary, ashamed, tired, an artist caught drawing. A faint amber hint of Earth qi in the sand lines. Palette: sand, dust-grey, dull gold.

people.imagined: Her counting house after the shutters close. She sits very straight with a brass steelyard weight on a cord at her wrist, listening to a nervous borrower with her eyes closed, counting soundlessly on the other hand.
people.subject: The moment: seated bolt upright at a counting table, eyes half closed, she counts under her breath on her fingers while she listens. Face: a long, narrow, severe face with high cheekbones and a straight nose, fine papery skin with deep lines running from nose to mouth, thin grey brows, level dark eyes, a thin unsmiling mouth; she looks about sixty. Hair: iron grey, scraped smooth back into a tight low bun at the nape with a plain black wooden pin. Body: tall, narrow, ramrod straight, no lean at all. Clothing: a robe of heavy black wool-silk, plain, high collar buttoned, long sleeves, nothing else on it; at the throat a narrow strip of white inner collar. Hands and objects: on the left wrist, hanging by a thin cord, a small brass steelyard weight shaped like a pear; a gold ring bearing a tiny balance on her right forefinger; her fingers on a wooden abacus whose beads are unmarked. Background: dark wood shelves, brass scale pans, a lamp. Light: a single lamp from the upper left, warm, the rest dark. Expression: patient, unmoved, listening with all her attention. Faint brass-gold Metal qi hint at the weight. Palette: black, brass, grey.

people.imagined: On the slip of the Bào yard beside a half-planked hull, in the morning tar-smoke. He is running his palm along a keel, one shoulder lower than the other, smiling at the grain.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a half-built hull on the slip, he runs his palm along a pine plank with a look of fondness. Face (most important: the bald head and the sunken left shoulder): a broad, bald, sunburnt head scattered with freckles, a heavy brow, small bright blue eyes in deep crow's feet, a wide flat nose peeling at the tip, a grey stubble beard, a brave crooked smile; the left shoulder visibly lower than the right so his whole frame leans. Body: broad and thick as a mast, big hands, strong. Clothing: a sleeveless jerkin of tarred undyed canvas over a coarse dark-blue linen shirt with rolled sleeves, a leather belt; clean and well made, with black tar at the cuffs only. Hands and objects: his right hand flat on a pale pine plank; across the front of him a short heavy iron anchor on a rope, hung on the left shoulder as if it were a bag; a small brass fog bell on a cord at his belt, in frame. Background: the curved ribs of a ship under construction, blurred, a grey sea beyond, fine drifting wood-smoke. Light: cool morning light from the upper left, pearly sea haze. Expression: stubborn warmth, pride in the work. A faint pale-teal Water hint in the haze. Palette: pine yellow, tar black, sea blue-grey.

people.imagined: A back room of a debt broker's house in Ngũ Cốc Thành, near midnight. She sits with her back to the wall facing the door, writing left-handed, and has just heard a footstep outside. She does not look up yet.
people.subject: The moment: at night she sits with her back against a wall, facing a door out of frame, her left hand mid-stroke on a sheet of tally marks, and lifts only her eyes. Face: a narrow, pale, pointed face, sharp cheekbones, a long thin nose, dark circles under watchful black eyes, straight thin brows drawn slightly together, a flat mouth, a small scar on the chin; she looks about twenty-eight. Hair: black, smooth, tied back low in a knot with a plain iron pin, nothing loose. Body: narrow, upright, tense at the shoulders. Clothing: a robe of fine grey cotton, with panels of a different grey sewn in at the elbows, a cross collar and narrow sleeves; at her throat a pale jade disc on a black cord (a pledge-stone, plain, polished), clearly visible. Hands and objects: a writing brush in her left hand, held low; in the right a single coin on the table's edge, a coin with a small square hole, struck new. Background: a bare plaster wall, a lamp with a paper shade, shelves of tied bundles of paper. Light: one oil lamp from the lower right, warm, lighting the underside of the jaw. Expression: still, wary, patient, the kind of calm that is waiting. A very faint greenish-silver hint of Water and Metal in the lamp's glint. Palette: ash, charcoal, celadon.

people.imagined: The banker in the year before the crash, at the desk of his lending house in Kim Cốc Thành, open-handed and certain. He is signing something with a flourish and smiling at someone across the desk who has asked for more time.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He is a banker at his desk in the year before his ruin, smiling openly across it. Face: a round, soft, trusting face with full cheeks, bright wide-set eyes, high arched brows, a small plump mouth smiling generously, a double chin, a neat black moustache and a small beard. He looks about fifty-five. Hair: black going grey at the temples, in a tidy topknot held by a gold pin. Body: well-fed, round-shouldered, a comfortable man leaning easily back. Clothing: a fine robe of dark-green silk with gold-thread coins woven at the hem and sleeves, a wide brocade sash, a cap with a small jade bead; the clothes of prosperity, perfectly neat. Hands and objects: a brush in his right hand over a blank page of paper; at his elbow a stack of four thick bound volumes tied with red cord; a gold counting coin on the desk. His fingers are plump and ringless except for one small gold band, his sleeves are carefully turned back, and the lamp glints on his cheeks and the bridge of his nose. Background: dark carved shelves and a hanging lantern, soft and blurred. Light: warm yellow lamp light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: An open, easy smile with warm, trusting eyes and relaxed brows, a face with no suspicion. Palette: faded green, old gold, cream-yellow.

people.imagined: Under the largest apricot tree of Hạnh Hoa Thị in his clinic, long ago, a poor child's burned hand held gently in both his, as he tells the child's mother not to pay him.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He sits under a blossoming apricot tree holding a child's bandaged hand in both of his, looking down at it. Face: a lean, long, weathered face, kind but stubborn, a high forehead, deep-set dark eyes with heavy lids, thick white brows, a straight nose, a firm mouth just curling in a smile, a long thin white beard; about sixty. Hair: white and thin, in a small topknot, a wooden pin through it. Body: tall, thin, slightly stooped, long arms. Clothing: a plain robe of unbleached hemp-cloth dyed pale brown with tea, clean and mended with matching stitches, a cord belt, sleeves tied back; a satchel of herb bundles on a strap. Hands and objects: the child's hand in his, wrapped in a pale green leaf and a clean strip of cloth; a ladle and a small gourd beside him on a flat stone. Background: a great gnarled apricot trunk and drifts of white-pink blossom, blurred. Light: soft light through petals from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: gentle, stubborn compassion. A faint green Wood hint at the leaf. Palette: faded cream, apricot pink, tea brown.

people.imagined: On the white beach of Bạch Sa the first year of the jetty, a young junk-builder standing hands on hips before his first hull on the sand, grinning, pine shavings in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He stands on a white sand beach in front of the ribs of his first junk, hands on his hips, grinning. Face: a square, open, sunburnt face with a wide jaw, thick black brows, bright small eyes, a straight nose, a wide gap-toothed grin, short black stubble, pine shavings stuck in the hair; about forty-five. Hair: black, thick, tied in a rough knot with a strip of blue cloth. Body: broad, solid, short-legged, built like a plank. Clothing: a plain short jacket of undyed linen with a wide open collar, a canvas apron stiff with tar, wide trousers rolled to the knee; clean, sturdy, well fitted. Hands and objects: in his right hand a heavy wooden adze with a curved head, resting on the shoulder; at his feet a coil of rope. Shavings curl around his bare feet, the tar on his apron has dried to a dark gloss, and his shadow lies short and sharp on the white sand. Background: the pale ribs of an unfinished hull on white sand, a faint sea and a short wooden jetty behind. Light: bright open sea light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: proud, cheerful, content. Palette: sand white, pine yellow, faded blue.

people.imagined: An instrument stall in Thiều Âm Thị. A farmer has just set a green-crusted bronze bell on her counter. She taps it once with a fingernail, eyes closed, before she has looked at it, and is already naming its century.
people.subject: The moment: eyes closed, she taps a bronze bell on her counter with one long fingernail, listening to the ring. Face (most important: very long ears dragged down by heavy bronze rings): a long, oval, pale face with a high forehead, a thin straight nose, narrow half-closed eyes, thin arched brows, a thin tight smile of superiority; her ears long, the lobes dragged low by three heavy bronze rings each, clearly visible at the sides. Hair: black, in a tall, smooth, pinned knot at the crown with a bronze comb. Body: tall, thin-necked, upright, a gliding bearing. Clothing: a robe of dark green-bronze silk with a high stiff collar and narrow sleeves, a sash of dull gold; a green sheen like old metal. Hands and objects: a pale bronze bell the size of a fist on the counter, crusted green, struck by her right forefinger's long nail; on her left hand a round bronze mirror held at her chest, its back green with age. Background: blurred shelves of bronze bells and old instruments, dark. Light: dim, from the upper left, bronze glints. Expression: cool, superior, fully absorbed. A faint ring of golden Metal sound-shimmer around the bell. Palette: bronze, verdigris green, black.

people.imagined: His river-bank stall at Đào Sa Thị, mid-argument with a boatman over the price of a ward. He is red in the face, and a half-burned seal sits in his hand while he thumps the counter with the other.
people.subject: The moment: at a riverside stall he thumps the counter with his fist, red-faced, arguing about a price. Face (most important: red face, scar and red knuckles): a broad red-faced man with a short thick neck, a heavy jaw, small narrow angry eyes under thick black brows, a wide mouth turned down, short black stubble; down the right arm and up to the wrist a long shining burn scar, the hands creased with ground cinnabar red. About forty-two. Hair: black, thick, cut short and untidy, a headband of faded red cloth. Body: thick, short, muscular, shoulders forward. Clothing: a short dark-blue jacket of fine cotton with the right sleeve pushed up to the elbow to show the scar, a canvas apron over it, a cord belt; clean and sound. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small stone seal whose face is half burned away, held up like a warning; on the counter stacks of yellow talisman paper painted with red cinnabar strokes, no legible marks, only splashes of red. Background: river boats and wet wooden posts, blurred. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left, red reflected up from the paper. Expression: stung pride, wrath, wounded. A hint of red-orange in the ink. Palette: cinnabar red, river grey-blue, paper yellow.

people.imagined: On the steppe road in rain, leading the caravan. He walks beside the first cart with water running off his felt coat, watching the sky as if it had a grudge, one hand resting on a wheel.
people.subject: The moment: on a rain-soaked steppe road he walks beside the lead cart, head turned up to a grey sky, rain running off his hat. Face: a long, serious, heavy-jawed face like a copy of a big man's without the laugh; wide forehead, narrow deep-set brown eyes, thick straight brows, a long nose, a firm mouth turned slightly down, a few days of beard; cautious, patient. Hair: dark brown, wet, tied back in a short tail under a round felt cap. Body: tall and broad-framed like his father but lean, shoulders hunched against the rain. Clothing: a herder's coat of grey-brown felt, long and heavy, clean and well sewn, a high collar turned up, a plain leather belt, wide boots; no ornament. Hands and objects: his left hand on a round shield slung across the back, its rim showing at the shoulder; the right hand rests on a wet cart wheel; a bundled bale of wool glimmers wet in the cart behind him. Background: a flat grey steppe, a line of carts with felt hoods, blurred, one dry patch of sunlight far off. Light: flat grey rain light from the upper left. Expression: serious, dry, patient, a faint private ache. Water-blue grey hint in the rain. Palette: grey, felt brown, cold green.

people.imagined: Behind his counter in Hạc Đinh Thị at closing time, a customer's coin between his teeth. He has just bitten it, his eyes narrowed, and is still deciding whether to say it is false.
people.subject: The moment: behind a counter he bites a coin, eyes narrowed, glancing sideways at the unseen customer. Face (most important: the coin gripped in the teeth): a small, dry, lined face like a walnut, thin sharp nose, small narrow suspicious eyes, thin grey brows, a pinched mouth with a silver coin clamped between his teeth; a goatee of thin grey hairs. About fifty-eight. Hair: thin grey, combed flat, a small black skullcap. A few white hairs escape the skullcap at the temples. Body: small, dry and narrow-shouldered, hunched over the counter. Clothing: a robe of fine dark-brown silk with a high buttoned collar, long sleeves with cuffs of black cloth to keep them clean, and a plain black sash; neat and prosperous. Hands and objects: bony hands spread on a counter inlaid with shell, silver and flecks of stone; small piles of shell coin, silver pieces and little pale spirit stones in front of him in three neat rows; a small brass scale. Background: dark wooden shelves of cash boxes, a lamp. Light: a lamp from the upper left, hard and yellow. A glint from the silver rows of coins lights the underside of his chin. Expression: suspicious, patient, bone-dry. A faint ochre Earth glimmer at the stones. Palette: brown, silver, shell white.

people.imagined: A cramped room above a shop in Lam Yên Thị at night. She leans over a soapstone block with a tiny knife, the loupe on its ribbon swung up on her forehead, copying a pill seal by a candle.
people.subject: The moment: at night she bends over a soapstone block with a tiny cutting knife, a jeweller's loupe swung up onto her forehead. Face: a small, neat, pale face with a pointed chin, smooth skin, large dark attentive eyes, fine straight brows, a small closed mouth, a smudge of ink on one cheek; she looks about twenty-six. Hair: black, in two neat buns at the back of her head, a few strands loose across her cheek. Body: slight, neat, with a slight lean forward over the work. Clothing: a plain, neat robe of dark-green cotton with a cross collar and narrow sleeves, clean; a thin ribbon round her neck carrying a seal-cutter's brass loupe. Hands and objects: her right hand holds the tiny knife; the left presses the soapstone block, which is half carved with a small round pattern of dots; a few round blue-green pills on a white cloth beside her. Background: a dark small room, a window with a paper pane, a bundle of herbs hanging. Light: one candle from the lower left, orange, strong shadows. Expression: quiet, intent, a little guilty. A hint of red-orange Fire warmth in the candle. Palette: dark green, candle orange, soapstone grey.

people.imagined: The clinic yard at dawn. She has just rolled her sleeves to the elbow and knelt to wash her hands in a basin before the first patient. She glances up, brave and a little impatient, as someone calls from the gate.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she kneels at a basin of water, sleeves rolled to the elbows, and looks up quickly toward a voice at the gate. Face: a broad, honest, sun-browned farm-girl face with strong cheekbones, wide-set clear brown eyes, thick straight brows, a short nose, a wide mouth ready to speak, a small cut healing on one cheek; about thirty. Hair: dark brown, in one thick braid over the shoulder tied with a green ribbon. Body: broad-shouldered, strong forearms, upright, with the build of someone who carried water as a child. Clothing: a plain robe of pale-green hemp, cross collar, the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a clean white apron over it, a cloth cord belt; neat and well fitted. Hands and objects: both hands in the basin, clean and long-fingered; a roll of nine wooden needles on a cloth at her side; a small round gourd by the basin. Background: the clinic's courtyard wall, the foot of a great apricot tree, blurred. Light: cool bright dawn from the upper left, a pale rim on her hair. Expression: ready, brave, a bit impatient. A faint pale-green hint of Wood qi on the water. Palette: pale green, wood brown, white.

people.imagined: A granary yard under a hot sun. He has wound his surveyor's cord round his forearm and is pacing out a ward ring in the dust, counting aloud, quick and cocksure. Someone has said his master laid it differently.
people.subject: The moment: in a sunbaked yard he paces out a circle, chin raised, one eyebrow lifted at an unseen challenger. Face: a sharp, sunburnt, quick face with a long straight nose, narrow bright black eyes, one brow slightly higher than the other, a lean jaw, a half-smile of conceit; about twenty-eight. Hair: black, short, bound by a strip of red cloth round the forehead. Body: lean, quick, athletic, a stance leaning forward. His hips are turned, one shoulder forward, with the poised weight of a runner just before the start. Clothing: a robe of sand-brown cotton, sleeves cut off at the elbow, a short belt; clean, well cut, dusty at the hem. The sleeveless sides of the robe are edged with stitching in a darker brown thread, and the belt has a brass buckle in the shape of a small circle; sand clings to the hem. Hands and objects: a long surveyor's cord of knotted hemp wound round his right forearm from wrist to elbow, in clear view; in his left hand a small square stone seal; in his belt a rolled little banner of plain cloth. Background: rounded earth granaries with thatched roofs, blurred, a hot pale sky. Beyond the yard a long thatched granary roof and a line of low mud walls, and in the distance a tall caravan beacon of stacked stones. Light: hard white noon light from the upper left. The glare bleaches the dust to white and leaves a sharp blue shadow under his chin. Expression: cocky, ambitious, hungry. A very faint blue Water and ochre hint in the dust. Palette: sand, brown, a stripe of red.

people.imagined: Walking down a lane of Thạch Kiều Thành, he raps each wall with a knuckle and tilts his head to listen, as he does everywhere, plaster to the elbows, sure that his wards are the thicker ones.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a lane, he raps a stone wall with his knuckles, head tilted to listen. Face: a heavy-jawed, square face, rough, with a broad flat nose, thick brows, small narrow eyes, a thick neck, a mouth half open as if about to boast; white plaster dust in the stubble. Hair: black and cropped short, a patch of white plaster in it. Body: broad, thick-armed, short-legged, a mason's body. He leans a little toward the wall with his head cocked and his heavy shoulders hunched in an attentive way. Clothing: a robe of undyed grey linen, clean, with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a leather belt with a tool loop, grey wide trousers; forearms plaster-white from wrist to elbow. The leather belt carries a trowel, a plumb line weight of lead and a small pot of lime on three loops, and the knees of the trousers are plastered white. Hands and objects: the right forearm and fist rapping a wall; in the left hand a flat stone seal with a square face, held low. On his left wrist is a thick cord with a flat bone bead for a charm. Background: a long grey stone wall of an arched bridge-city, blurred, with a curved arch. Light: flat midday light from the upper left, bright white on the wall. The hard light shows each fleck of white in the stubble. Expression: arrogant, diligent, listening intently. A faint ochre Earth hint on the stone. Palette: plaster white, stone grey, ochre.

people.imagined: Her teahouse beside the ferry quay. A traveller has stepped off the boat looking lost. She smiles, pours tea, and already knows whom she will introduce him to and for how much.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table in a teahouse, she pours tea and smiles warmly at a traveller outside the frame. Face: a plump, round, smiling face, soft dimples, warm dark eyes narrowed by smiling, thin well-drawn brows, a small mouth, a double chin; a very calm glance that does not smile with the mouth. About forty. Hair: black, in a high glossy knot with two lacquered combs and a ferry-blue ribbon. Body: plump, comfortable, relaxed, with an air of friendship. Clothing: a robe of ferry-blue silk, a pale-blue lining at the cuffs, a wide sash of darker blue with a small knotted cord at the waist; fine, rounded, spotless. Hands and objects: pouring tea from a small teapot with her right hand; from her left sleeve the corner of a thick little book of plain blue cloth peeks out, tied shut; a small knotted cord on her wrist. Her fingers are plump and ringed with a single jade band, a thin fold of steam rises from the spout, and a second small cup waits across the table. Background: a window onto a river quay with a ferry boat and tea shelves, blurred. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, cool blue reflections from the water. Expression: warm, patient, calculating. A faint blue Water hint in the steam. Palette: blue, tea brown, cream.

people.imagined: His pawn shop beside the farewell pavilion. A failed boy has laid down a sword. He has screwed his loupe into one eye, and is looking at the boy's face with it, not the sword.
people.subject: The moment: behind a pawnbroker's counter he looks at the viewer's face through a loupe screwed into one eye. Face (most important: the loupe in the right eye): a thin, patient, kind-eyed face with a long nose, high forehead, deep lines, grey stubble, an enlarged glass eye from the brass loupe on a string, and a soft honest smile; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, in a small topknot with a bone pin. Body: thin and stooped, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a robe of fine pale grey-blue cloth, a long jacket of undyed wool with fur trim at the collar for the cold, a plain cord belt; neat and warm. Hands and objects: his left hand lays flat on a long sword in a plain scabbard on the counter; a small tag tied to the hilt; on the shelf behind, a row of other swords hung with identical tags, blurred. The loupe makes his right eye look twice its size, a lamp throws a small gold circle on the counter, and the fur at his collar is dusted with snow. Background: a pale cold shop with a window looking on snow and a pavilion roof. Light: cold white light from a window at the upper left, a warm lamp below. Expression: patient, kind, measuring. A faint pale-green Wood hint, otherwise cold. Palette: grey-blue, white, steel.

people.imagined: On a quay in the northern port, a crate of cassia opened in front of her. She holds a curl of bark to her nose, ring-covered fingers spread, and is calculating the price with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a quay she holds a curl of cassia bark under her nose, eyes half closed with pleasure, as crates open behind. Face: a handsome, round-cheeked, merry face, golden-brown skin, quick dark eyes, long lashes, thick curved brows, a full mouth smiling, a small beauty mark by the lip; about thirty-two. Hair: black, in a thick braid wound round the head and pinned with gold pins. Body: sturdy, strong-shouldered, relaxed. She leans her weight on one hip against a crate with a relaxed, delighted slouch and her free hand on her waist. Clothing: a fur collar gone brown with cassia dust on a rich robe of cinnamon-coloured silk, cross collar, wide sleeves, a wide brown sash; neat and prosperous. The cinnamon silk has a stitched pattern of tiny curled leaves along the cuff, and the wide sash is wound twice and tied with a flat knot at the left hip; the fur collar is thick and matted. Hands and objects: a gold ring on every finger but the thumbs, ten bright rings; in her right hand a curl of dark cassia bark, in her left a small paper twist of pepper. Each of the ten rings is different, a plain band, a stone, a twisted wire, a signet of a leaf, and one has a tiny bell. Background: stacked crates and baskets of spices, a sailing ship, blurred. Coolies carry a sack of pepper down a plank in the distance, and a rope-slung crate swings from a crane, with tall mast-tops showing against a pale-blue sky. Light: bright warm sunshine from the upper left, golden. Expression: delighted, shrewd, generous. A faint warm red-orange Fire and green Wood glow at the spice. Palette: cinnamon brown, gold, spice red.

people.imagined: The pine market at dusk. He is stirring a small pot of sticky pine-root balm for the road watch, and one of the watchmen has just made the old joke about his face. He laughs, too gently.
people.subject: The moment: stirring a small iron pot over a low fire, he looks up at an unseen joker and smiles shyly. Face (most important: the long, pitted horse-face): a very long face with a long jaw and long upper lip, deeply pitted skin, a big nose, big kind brown eyes, thin brows, large teeth in a shy smile; about thirty-eight. Hair: thin brown, tied back in a short tail with a twist of straw. Body: tall, narrow, stooped, big hands. His knees are bent so that he can keep his face level with the pot, shoulders stooped, long arms folded over his knees. Clothing: a robe of fine olive-green cotton, long and clean, with a brown apron over it, sleeves tucked up; nothing fancy. The olive robe has a high cross-collar and plain cuffs, the apron is stained brown with resin, and the sleeves are held back by a cord of braided pine bark. Hands and objects: hands stained resin-amber to the wrists, one holding a long wooden spoon in a small pot of amber paste; beside him a round gourd bottle corked with pine bark. A small stack of folded green leaves lies beside the pot, ready to wrap the finished paste. Background: a stand of dark pine trunks, small lanterns, blurred market stalls. A watchman in a leather cap leans on a spear at the edge of the firelight, laughing, and further off the dark wall of the pine wood. Light: orange firelight from the lower right, a dusk-blue sky. Embers fly up and make small orange sparks against the dusk. Expression: humble, gentle, a bit hurt, smiling anyway. A faint green Wood hint in the steam. Palette: olive, amber, dusk blue.

people.imagined: Beside his kneeling camel at the desert well. He pulls his collar down to show a stranger the camel-bite scar before he will give his name, grinning to see the stranger's face.
people.subject: The moment: pulling his collar aside to show his left shoulder, he grins at a stranger. Face: a lean, hawkish, sun-black face, deep creases, a hooked nose, bright amber eyes squinting, a white-toothed grin, a trimmed black beard; about forty-seven. Hair: black, with a turban of dust-coloured cloth wound round the head, the tail hanging. Body: lean, tall and rangy, a strong stance. He stands with his hips tilted and one hand tucked into the red sash, a showman's easy swagger. Clothing: a long coat of sand-yellow wool, well cut, open at the left collar to reveal a white ridged camel-bite scar on the shoulder, a wide red sash, loose trousers; clean and fit for a master caravaneer. The sand-yellow coat has wide cuffs with a black braid trim, the sash is knotted with a long tassel, and the loose trousers are tucked into soft dusty boots. Hands and objects: one hand on a rope bridle; at his side the head of a camel, bridled with red tassels, its yellow teeth showing; a small leather bag of salt on his hip. On the right hand he wears a heavy brass ring; the bag of salt at his hip is stitched with a pattern of small crosses. Background: a dun desert and a well with a stone rim, blurred, a pale sky. Behind the camel a line of loaded animals waits patiently by the well, a boy draws water, and the dunes roll away to a bleached sky. Light: harsh bright desert sun from the upper left. Expression: showy, generous, mercurial. A faint ochre Earth and warm red hint in the sand. Palette: sand, red sash, amber.

people.imagined: A ledger room in Nhạn Thanh Thành, the old man's door ajar behind him. He moves a bead on a jade abacus while his eyes are on the door, his memory already holding the whole page.
people.subject: The moment: at a ledger desk he flicks one bead of a jade abacus and looks up past it toward a half-open door. Face: a soft, narrow, pale young face with a gentle mouth, soft dark eyes and long lashes, a straight nose, thin brows lifted slightly in worry; about thirty. Hair: black, neat, in a plain knot with a wooden pin. A single strand of hair has fallen loose across his forehead and he does not brush it back. Body: slim, narrow-shouldered, a clerk's careful posture. His wrists are thin and the left rests on the desk edge with the fingers curled, keeping the beads still. Clothing: a robe of dark-blue cotton, high-collared, with clean white cuffs, a grey sash; very neat, well cut. The cuffs are two small white bands, the sash has a flat knot, and the collar is a little too high; a pocket in the sleeve holds a folded cloth. Hands and objects: a small abacus whose beads are green jade, in his hands; open on the desk a thick ledger whose pages show only faint ruled lines; a brush rest and a lump of ink. Background: a quiet counting room with wooden shelves of bound volumes, blurred. The door behind him is half open on a corridor, with a long dark shadow of a person standing in it. Light: soft window light from the upper left. The cool light falls on the desk and leaves the doorway in shadow. Expression: gentle, careful, a little guilty. A faint blue Water hint in the jade. Palette: blue, jade green, paper cream.

people.imagined: On the harbour wall at Yên Ba, a wind in her salt-whitened braids, looking south over the water with her rope-burned hands on the stone. Her father is calling her to the yard and she is pretending not to hear.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a harbour wall with her back half-turned to the yard, she looks hungrily south over the sea, braids blowing. Face: a long, strong, sunburnt face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, wide grey eyes narrowed against the wind, thick dark brows, a wide mouth set in impatience; about thirty-five. Hair: three long braids bleached white at the ends by salt, hanging past the shoulder, one tied with a bit of tarred twine. The braids end in small knots of tarred twine and the wind whips two of them across her mouth. Body: tall like her father, broad-shouldered and lean, a sailor's easy balance. Clothing: a short jacket of sea-blue canvas with a high collar, a wide leather belt, loose white trousers rolled at the ankle; clean and well sewn. Hands and objects: both hands flat on a stone wall, palms visibly rope-burned and scarred; a small iron anchor charm on a cord at her neck. Background: a wide grey-green sea and a harbour with masts, blurred, white gulls. Light: bright sea wind light from the upper left. Spray catches the sun in tiny white sparks round her shoulders. Expression: restless, brave, longing. A faint pale-teal Water hint in the foam. Palette: sea blue, salt white, tarred black.

people.imagined: At the festival's betting stand he shakes a pair of dice in his purse and winks with one eye, the other already half closed, about to tell a rich man something he will not like.
people.subject: The moment: at a betting stand he rattles a dice purse beside his ear, one eye half shut as if winking. Face: a sharp, friendly, freckled young face with a wide mouth in a crooked smile, one eye permanently half shut, a thin nose, tousled eyebrows, quick sparkle in the open eye; about forty. Hair: black and unruly, a small black feather stuck at an angle in a headband. Body: wiry, light, bouncing on his toes. He stands on the balls of his feet, shoulders loose and one arm raised, as though about to start a dance. Clothing: a short jacket of bright cotton in mustard yellow with a collar flipped up, clean; a belt of knotted cord with a small purse; wide trousers. The jacket has a double row of brass buttons and mismatched sleeves, one mustard and one slightly paler; a short red tassel hangs from the belt. Hands and objects: a drawstring purse in his right hand with two white bone dice just visible at its mouth, tinkling; his left hand holding a small round wooden tally token. Background: Behind him, the betting stall has a row of painted counters in red and black, a chalkboard with only scribbled lines, and a bored clerk with a straw hat. Light: lantern light, warm, from the upper left. Lanterns in red paper hang overhead and warm his cheeks. Expression: cheeky, honest, challenging. A hint of blue-green Water in a tilting glint. Palette: mustard, black, lantern red.

people.imagined: In the Bào yard at evening he counts a plank length on his fingers, the three missing fingertips folded under, quietly satisfied, careful that no one sees what the copper-sheathed hulls are for.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight-backed by a keel, he counts on his hand, with three fingertips missing, lips moving. Face (most important: the hand with three missing fingertips): a lean, quiet, square face with a plank-straight back behind it, a long nose, calm grey eyes, short grey brows, a closed mouth, grey stubble; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, close-cropped under a cloth cap. Body: very straight, spare, strong, a craftsman's balance. His left hand is raised level with his chin and his right hangs beside the hip, shoulders square and still like a plumb line. Clothing: a long jerkin of fine undyed linen with an apron of tarred canvas, sleeves rolled to the elbow, clean; a belt with a wooden mallet loop. The apron has a long pocket for pencils on the left side, and the linen jerkin is cut with a straight collar and a single bone toggle; the trousers are rolled to above the ankle. Hands and objects: the left hand raised, three fingers plainly ending at the first knuckle; the right hand holding a flat carpenter's pencil of charcoal and a plank of fresh pale wood; beneath his arm a sheet of thin copper. A thin curl of copper foil is hooked over one ear like a pencil. Background: a half-built hull with a coppery sheen, a darkening evening yard, blurred. The hull's planking shows long strips of dull red-gold copper already tacked on, and beyond it the masts of moored ships against a rose-coloured sky. Light: low evening light from the upper left, orange on copper. Expression: reserved, content, private. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: copper, plank yellow, grey.

people.imagined: The furnace room at Vật Hoa Thị at night. A boy squats by the fire, fanning it, his burned chin glowing red. He has seen something in the ashes no one else has, and has told no one.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at a furnace mouth, he fans the coals with a palm-leaf fan and stares into the red. Face (most important: the burn-pocked chin and no eyelashes): a thin, boyish, soot-smudged face with a chin pocked with old burns, not an eyelash or eyebrow left, round pale eyes that never blink, a small open mouth; about eighteen. Hair: black, cropped very short, singed at the front. Scorched ends curl at the front like a singed brush. Body: thin, wiry, stooped, long arms. His back is hunched and his arms are long, his head forward with the stare of a boy who has seen something no one else has. Clothing: a short undyed linen jerkin and trousers with a leather apron scorched at the hem; clean, plain, sleeves rolled up. The apron has a burn hole at the pocket and a patch of different leather at the knee; the jerkin is tied at the front with a plain cord and the trousers are rolled to the shin. Hands and objects: one hand holds a big palm-leaf fan; the other a pair of long iron tongs holding a small pale grey stone, round and smooth like a peach stone. Background: a dark brick furnace glowing orange, blurred. Behind him the brick arch of the furnace, a rack of iron tools, a bucket of water with a floating ladle, and a heap of dull charcoal. Light: red-orange firelight from the lower front, the room dark. Sparks float up in the red light and glint on the stone in the tongs. Expression: awed, wordless, secretive. A strong warm red-orange Fire hint. Palette: furnace red, soot black, ash grey.

people.imagined: In the clinic yard she sits down mid-sentence on a stool, fever-bright, apologises and stands again, a rolled practice bandage in her hands, while a sick child waits unnoticed at the gate behind her.
people.subject: The moment: halfway between sitting and standing, she apologises with a flustered smile, a rolled bandage in her hands. Face: a thin, pale, reed-like face with fever-bright flushed cheekbones, large wet dark eyes, a pointed chin, thin brows, a quick small mouth; about twenty. Hair: black, thin, in two short braids tied with string. Body: thin as a reed, bony wrists, shoulders drawn in. Her knees are slightly bent and her hands clasp the roll tight to her stomach, as if she has risen too fast. Clothing: a plain robe of pale-brown hemp, neat, with a green sash and a white apron; clean and well fitted. The pale-brown robe has long sleeves cuffed back twice and a green sash tied with a neat bow; on the apron a few stains of green juice mark the hem. Hands and objects: hands wrapped round a tightly rolled strip of white bandage; at her side a mortar with a pestle and some roots; a single wooden needle between two fingers. At the belt hangs a small clay bottle of herbal tonic and a pinch of dried leaves in a paper twist. Background: the clinic's gate and a blossom tree, a small figure waiting in the rain far behind, blurred and dim. Light: soft grey rainy light from the upper left. The soft rain-light makes the flush on her cheekbones look like two small coins of red. Expression: flustered, bright, a flicker of impatience. A pale green Wood hint at the roots. Palette: pale brown, green, grey.

people.imagined: On a half-washed-out mountain path, a porter stops at a broken bridge with two sealed wooden boxes strapped to his back, and sets off through the water without a word, as he has done every day since the cure.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a washed-out bridge in a rain-swollen river, a porter hitches two sealed boxes higher and steps in. Face (most important: the face blotched yellow): a gaunt face with skin blotched an unhealthy yellow where poison once ran, hollow cheeks, steady brown eyes, thick brows, a grim set mouth; about fifty. Hair: black and grey, in a tight knot under a conical straw hat. Body: strong, bow-legged, a heavy-boned porter. He stands with his bowed legs braced and the frame's straps cutting into his shoulders, leaning into the load like an ox. Clothing: a clean, plain, knee-length robe of dark-blue cotton, belted, over rolled trousers that show mud to the knee, under a short rain cape of woven straw layered like shingles. Hands and objects: a carrying frame on his back with two small sealed wooden boxes tied shut with cord, a wax seal in each, unmarked; his right hand grips a pole. The two boxes are of pale wood bound with red cord and sealed with blobs of dark wax, each the size of a loaf of bread. Background: The broken bridge hangs one plank over the brown torrent, and a tall peak with a cap of cloud stands across the gorge. Light: cold grey rain light from the upper left. Expression: stoic, loyal, unflinching. A faint green-yellow Wood hint at the boxes. Palette: yellow blotch, blue-grey, rain green.

people.imagined: At the money-changer's counter while her father naps. She pushes her father's too-big spectacles up with a knuckle and weighs a coin on a tiny scale, with the strongbox she has been reading half open beneath.
people.subject: The moment: behind the counter she pushes oversized spectacles up her nose with a knuckle and peers at a coin. Face: a small, clever, round face with a snub nose, big serious dark eyes magnified by oversized round brass spectacles sliding down the nose, straight brows, a determined mouth; about thirty. Hair: black, in two high buns with red cord. Body: small, slim, upright. She sits up on a high stool with her elbows on the counter and her feet not quite touching the floor. Clothing: a robe of ochre-brown cotton with a clean white collar, sleeves tied back with cord, a wide sash; a little too large, fitting well. The collar is a clean white linen and the ochre robe's sleeves are tied up above the wrist with red cord; a short apron guards the front. Hands and objects: the right forefinger on her glasses; in the left a coin held up to the light; on the counter small neat piles of shell coin and silver beside a small brass scale; a half-open strongbox. The coin she holds has a square hole and a tiny scratch across its face; the scale pans are of bright brass and swing a little. Background: dark shelves of cash boxes, blurred, a lamp. A sleeping old man in a chair, her father, is half-seen in the shadow at the back, his chin on his chest, with a pair of spectacles dangling from his hand. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. The lamp glints on the thick lenses and doubles the size of her eyes. Expression: serious, honest, a little worried. A faint ochre Earth hint on the coins. Palette: ochre, brass, black.

people.imagined: In the counting house hall, someone else is talking and he turns the heavy jade ring on his thumb, eyes drifting to the ceiling, hair perfectly oiled, bored and sure that he will inherit it all.
people.subject: The moment: standing with arms folded he turns a heavy jade ring on his thumb and gazes past the speaker. Face: a handsome, narrow, haughty face, a sharp nose, thin brows raised, cold black eyes, a thin curling mouth; about twenty-four. Hair: black, oiled flat and glossy, parted exactly in the middle, a small gold pin. Body: slim, tall, shoulders thrown back, chin up. His arms are folded across his chest and one shoulder leans against a pillar, his head tilted in the pose of a man waiting to be impressed. Clothing: a robe of rich earth-brown silk, heavy, with a stiff high collar and gold-thread edging, a stiff dark sash; very fine and perfectly pressed. The robe is embroidered with a band of small gold coins woven at the hem, and the stiff collar is fastened with a gold hook; the sash holds a small jade seal. Hands and objects: a jade ring far too big for his thumb that he turns with his forefinger; a ledger bound in brown leather under his left arm. The ledger under his arm is bound in brown leather with brass corners and fastened by a gold clasp. Background: a counting house hall with dark pillars and brass scales, blurred. Other clerks stand blurred in a row at their desks, and at the far end a small grey-haired woman in black sits very straight. Light: even cool light from the upper left. A lamp in a brass bracket lights half his face and leaves the other cool. Expression: bored, arrogant, cold. A faint brass-gold Metal hint. Palette: brown, jade green, brass.

people.imagined: Dawn at the harbour, sulking. She has woken in a temper and scuffs out a ward figure in the sand with her bare heel, a fish-scale glitter on her wrist catching the light.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a sandy shore she scuffs out a drawn figure with her bare heel, glaring down. Face: a round, freckled, sun-darkened face with a stubborn chin, a snub nose, thick dark brows drawn together, bright black eyes, a mouth pressed hard; about seventeen. Hair: black, wild and salt-stiff, tied with a bit of fishing cord. Body: sturdy, strong, bare-legged, a fishwife's daughter. She stands with her arms stiff at her sides, shoulders forward, feet planted in the sand as she glowers. Clothing: a short tunic of sea-green cotton with a high neck and a rope belt, short trousers, clean and sound; no shoes, salt-cracked heels. The sea-green tunic has a patch of blue at the elbow and the rope belt has a small bone toggle; short trousers are rolled to above the knee and stained with salt. Hands and objects: on her left wrist a patch of fish-scale glitter, silver-blue, shining; a small cloth flag under her arm with a pattern of stars. Under her arm the little cloth flag shows a pattern of five yellow stars and a curve. Background: wet sand, a grey sea, boats pulled up, blurred. Wet sand scored with the half-erased lines of a drawn ward, a row of boats drawn up on the shore, and a thin pink band along the horizon. Light: cold pink-gold dawn from the left. The cold dawn makes the wet sand shine like pewter. Expression: sulky, defiant, quick-tempered. A faint blue Water shimmer at the scale. Palette: sea green, sand, silver.

people.imagined: On the ferry deck, running with a handful of notes, collar rumpled, sleep in the corner of his eye. His mother has found him another match, and he is running again, good-naturedly, laughing at himself.
people.subject: The moment: running along a ferry deck with a fistful of folded notes, collar flapping, glancing back and laughing. Face: a round, good-natured face with full cheeks, small clear eyes with sleep in one corner, soft brows, a wide laughing mouth, a little double chin; about twenty-four. Hair: black, tousled, half in a knot, falling loose. Body: soft, round-bellied, short-legged, bouncing. He leans forward on his toes with his belly bouncing and one hand flung back, the whole body a comic rush. Clothing: a robe of ferry-blue cotton with the collar rumpled and sleeves pushed up, a loose sash, soft shoes; clean and decent. The ferry-blue robe has a little embroidered wave along the hem, and the collar flaps open; the soft shoes are scuffed at the toes. Hands and objects: a fistful of small folded notes of blue paper in his right hand; his left holds up the hem of the robe as he runs; a small blue knotted cord at the wrist. Two small blue folded notes have fallen behind him and flutter in the air. Background: Passengers with bundles scatter from his path, a rope and rail on the deck, and the shore town of a river quay with a tea house sign far behind. Light: The bright river light flares off the water and makes the edges of the notes glow, from the upper left. Expression: good-natured, flustered, laughing. A pale blue Water hint in the spray. Palette: blue, cream, river grey.

people.imagined: At a stall beside the burned-out lane, she paints a ward in cinnabar-red mulberry ink with a steady hand, ink up to the second joint of each finger, and looks up proud and tense, thinking of the contest.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a stall, brush raised, she looks up from a long strip of yellow paper she is painting. Face (most important: the ink-black fingers, seen in the hands below): a strong oval face, olive skin, level dark eyes, firm brows, a straight nose, a mouth set in resolve, a smudge of red on the cheek; about thirty-two. Hair: black, in a neat low bun with a bamboo brush stuck through it. A few black hairs fall across her forehead and she has not noticed the ink streak among them. Body: slim, straight-backed, strong forearms. Clothing: a robe of dark-blue cotton with narrow sleeves, a cloth cord belt, a white apron stained with ink; very clean otherwise. Hands and objects: black ink to the second joint of every finger, in clear view; a fine brush in the right hand over a long strip of yellow paper marked only with red wavy strokes, no characters; a small ink stone and a bowl of red cinnabar on the table. Background: a plain market stall with hanging yellow papers, blurred. Light: soft daylight from the upper left. A little red light from the cinnabar bowl lies on the underside of her chin. Expression: proud, steady, ambitious. A faint green Wood hint in the ink. Palette: soot-black, saffron, cinnabar.

people.imagined: On the western caravan road at night. He sits by the fire with his brand-marked sword hand resting on his knee, saying nothing, and thinks of a woman who was not paid.
people.subject: The moment: sitting by a campfire, he looks into the flames, his sword hand lying open on his knee. Face: a hard, long, silent face with a long jaw, a flat nose, deep creases from nose to the corners of a mouth that turns down, grey eyes, heavy brows, short stubble; about fifty. Hair: black with grey, cropped, bareheaded. Body: lean, hard, upright, long limbs. He sits very upright on a log with his forearms resting on his knees and his hand turned open, motionless as a stone. Clothing: a long coat of grey-brown felt with a high collar, a wide belt, plain trousers; clean and well kept. The coat is of thick felt with a lining of dun sheepskin at the cuffs, and a long scarf of dull red is wound round the neck and tucked in. Hands and objects: on the back of the right sword hand a tattoo of a caravan brand, a dark mark like a small wheel in a circle with no letters; a plain straight sword in a leather scabbard laid across his knees. The tattooed brand shows a small circle with a spoke, blue-black against the weathered skin. Background: a night camp, camels asleep, dark steppe and a few stars, blurred. Beyond the fire a line of sleeping camels with their heads on the ground, a dark tent, and a wide sky of cold stars over flat land. Light: firelight from the lower left, warm on the hand and jaw. Expression: silent, hard, ashamed. A faint ochre Earth and cold grey-silver Metal hint. Palette: firelight orange, felt grey, black.

people.imagined: On the steps of the auction house in Vật Hoa Thị. A rich man has offered him double for what he knows. He counts the coins at the man's belt with his eyes and shakes his head.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a step he looks at an unseen man's belt, eyes counting, and shakes his head slowly. Face: a thin, pointed, quick face, a cowlick standing up, black bright narrow eyes, small ears, a thin mouth shut, black-rimmed nails showing at his chin; about sixteen. Hair: black with a cowlick sticking up at the crown. Body: small, thin, quick, a street boy. He stands on the second step with his weight leaning forward and his small shoulders squared against the man in front of him. Clothing: a short jacket of ochre cotton, clean, with elbow guards in a matching colour, a rope belt, short trousers; no shoes. The ochre jacket has elbow guards of the same colour and a double stitched seam down the front; a leather string holds a flat key at his neck. Hands and objects: hands with black fingernails, one clutching a small bundle of notes, the other held out palm-up; a pill in a twist of paper tucked behind one ear. The bundle in his fist is tied with thin red string and pressed to his chest. Background: Wide steps of grey stone rise behind him to a carved door and a knot of merchants in rich coats, blurred, with a banner of plain red cloth. Light: afternoon light from the upper left. Slanting light throws his shadow long and thin down the steps. Expression: shrewd, loyal, unbribed. A faint ochre Earth hint. Palette: ochre, black, grey stone.

people.imagined: A tea warehouse at Hồi Lan Thành in spring. She hugs her ledger like a child, tea stains on every cuff, and has just learned she was outbid again by the woman who pays in advance.
people.subject: The moment: standing between tea chests, hugging a ledger to her chest and frowning at a price board. Face: a pretty, serious, round face with large dark eyes, straight thin brows drawn together, a small nose, a determined small mouth; about twenty-five. Hair: black, in a high knot with a wooden comb. Body: slim, neat, upright, with sleeves of a clerk. She stands with her back straight and her knees together, the ledger held in both arms across her chest. Clothing: a robe of pale-green cotton, clean with a neat collar and narrow sleeves, a grey sash; every cuff stained pale brown with tea. The pale-green robe has a high neat collar edged with white stitching, the grey sash is tied in a flat bow, and the tea stains at the cuffs make pale brown rings like cups. Hands and objects: a thick ledger with a dark cover held under her left arm like a child; in her right hand a tea sample on a small white dish with a blue rim, a few dried leaves curled in it like small dark shells.  Background: Chests marked with painted leaves rise in stacks behind her, a cart of rice sacks stands at the door, and a price board with small plain painted discs hangs above. Light: The bright warm light slants through a high window and picks out the dust, from the upper left. Expression: serious, earnest, stung. A faint blue Water hint. Palette: tea brown, pale green, cream.
